       from.name AS from_party, to.name AS to_party, prev.id AS follows,
       c.kind AS claim_kind, c.holder AS claim_holder, cl.kind AS cleared_kind,
       auth.scope AS auth_scope, auth.valid_from AS auth_from, auth.valid_to AS auth_to, grantor.name AS auth_grantor
ORDER BY t.effective

MATCH (a:Asset {id: 'A1'})<-[:MOVES]-(t:Transfer)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[f:FOLLOWS]->(prev:Transfer)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)<-[:FROM]-(fromParty:Party)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:TO]->(toParty:Party)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[au:ACTED_UNDER]->(auth:Authority)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[ag:AGAINST]-(cl:Claim)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[ev:EVIDENCED_BY]->(doc:Document)
RETURN t.id AS transfer_id, t.effective AS effective, t.recorded AS recorded,
       fromParty.name AS from_party, toParty.name AS to_party,
       prev.id AS previous_transfer, t.odometer AS odometer, t.title_branded AS title_branded,
       cl.kind AS claim_kind, cl.holder AS claim_holder, cl.effective AS claim_effective,
       doc.kind AS doc_kind, doc.effective AS doc_effective
ORDER BY t.effective ASC

CALL {
  MATCH (a:Asset {id: 'A1'})<-[:MOVES]-(t:Transfer)
  RETURN t
}
MATCH (t)<-[:FROM]-(from:Party)
MATCH (t)-[:TO]->(to:Party)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[f:FOLLOWS]->(prev:Transfer)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[ag:AGAINST]->(claim:Claim)
OPTIONAL MATCH (claim)<-[cb:CLEARED_BY]-(release:Document)
RETURN t.id AS transfer_id, t.effective AS effective, t.recorded AS recorded,
       from.name AS from_name, to.name AS to_name, prev.id AS prev_id,
       t.by_agent AS agent, t.title_branded AS title_branded, t.odometer AS odometer,
       claim.kind AS claim_kind, claim.holder AS claim_holder, claim.effective AS claim_effective,

OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[f:FOLLOWS]->(prev:Transfer)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)<-[:FROM]-(fromParty:Party)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:TO]->(toParty:Party)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[ag:ACTED_UNDER]->(auth:Authority)
OPTIONAL MATCH (auth)-[gb:GRANTED_BY]->(grantor:Party)
OPTIONAL MATCH (auth)-[rev:REVOKED_BY]->(revDoc:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[ev:EVIDENCED_BY]->(p:Passage)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[agAgainst:AGAINST]->(claim:Claim)
RETURN t.id AS transfer, t.effective AS effective, t.recorded AS recorded,
       fromParty.name AS from_party, toParty.name AS to_party,
       t.by_agent AS agent, t.odometer AS odometer, t.title_branded AS branded,
       prev.id AS prev_transfer, auth.agent AS auth_agent, auth.scope AS auth_scope,
       auth.valid_from AS auth_from, auth.valid_to AS auth_to, grantor.name AS grantor,
       revDoc.kind AS rev_doc, p.id AS passage_id, p.text AS passage_text,
       claim.kind AS claim_kind, claim.holder AS claim_holder
ORDER BY t.effective ASC, t.recorded ASC

MATCH path = (a:Asset {id: 'A1'})<-[:MOVES]-(t:Transfer)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[f:FOLLOWS]->(prev)

MATCH (t:Transfer) MATCH (a:Asset) WHERE (a)<-[:MOVES]-(t) RETURN t.id, a.id

       p_from.name AS from_party, p_to.name AS to_party, prev.id AS prev_id,
       auth.scope AS auth_scope, auth.valid_from AS auth_from, auth.valid_to AS auth_to,
       p_grant.name AS auth_grantor, pas.id AS passage_id, pas.text AS passage_text
ORDER BY t.recorded, t.effective

       c.kind AS claim_kind, c.holder AS claim_holder, c.effective AS claim_effective,
       clr.kind AS clear_kind, clr.effective AS clear_effective,
       doc.kind AS doc_kind, doc_rev.kind AS rev_kind

args.query:
MATCH (a:Asset {id: 'A1'})<-[:MOVES]-(t:Transfer)
WHERE t.effective <= '2019-07-10'
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:FROM]->(from:Party)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:TO]->(to:Party)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:FOLLOWS]->(prev:Transfer)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:ACTED_UNDER]->(auth:Authority)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:AGAINST]->(claim:Claim)
OPTIONAL MATCH (claim)<-[:CLEARED_BY]-(rel:Document)
RETURN t.id AS transfer, t.effective AS effective, t.odometer AS odometer,
       from.name AS from_party, to.name AS to_party, prev.id AS prev_transfer,
       auth.agent AS auth_agent, auth.scope AS auth_scope,
       claim.kind AS claim_kind, claim.holder AS claim_holder, rel.effective AS rel_effective
ORDER BY t.effective
